passwordGuidance.empty: Choose at least {{min}} characters. A password manager can create a long secret. Satella cannot recover a forgotten Vault password.
passwordGuidance.tooShort: Vault password must be at least {{min}} characters. Satella cannot recover it.
passwordGuidance.considerLonger: Consider a longer password or a password manager. Forgotten Vault passwords cannot be recovered.
passwordGuidance.strongLength: Strong length. Satella cannot recover this Vault password.

unlock.title: Unlock your Vault
unlock.intro: Enter your Vault password. Satella cannot recover it. An incorrect password is indistinguishable from damaged Vault data.
unlock.requestFailed: The Vault could not be unlocked.

screenLock.title: Satella is locked
screenLock.intro: Screen lock hides the interface. Background Refresh may continue. This is not the same as closing the Vault.
screenLock.requestFailed: The Screen lock could not be dismissed.
screenLock.pinDisabledNote: Too many incorrect PIN attempts. Use your Vault password to unlock Satella again.

reset.title: Reset Satella
reset.warning: This permanently deletes the Vault, portfolio, custodian credentials, encrypted backups, and Vault metadata. You will return to first-run onboarding. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Security

passwordSection.heading: Vault password
passwordSection.description: Changing the Vault password rewraps the encryption key. Encrypted backups stay usable.
passwordSection.mismatchError: Vault password and confirmation do not match.

pinSection.heading: Screen-lock PIN
pinSection.mismatchError: Screen-lock PIN and confirmation do not match.

timeoutSection.label: Screen-lock timeout
timeoutSection.helperText: Lock hides the interface after inactivity. There is no Never option.

settings.privacyNote: Screen lock is interface privacy, not Vault encryption. Encryption protects copied files while the Vault is closed.
settings.licenseNote: SQLCipher Community Edition is included under the BSD-3-Clause license. Notices ship with this application.

restore.title: Restore Vault
restore.description: Restoring replaces this device's Vault with the contents of the selected export after validation succeeds.
restore.confirmLabel: Replace my current Vault and its data
restore.successToast: Vault restored. Unlock with the restored Vault's password.
restore.requestFailed: The Vault could not be restored.
